title: Integrate existing CODEOWNERS into review surfaces
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.16.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #192572

Human Note

phase 2 mergin in exsting list of owenrs into the finer grained form

Agent note
> This AI-assisted change moves the existing active CODEOWNERS assignments into the grouped review-surface
> taxonomy while preserving the effective owners for every tracked path. Unresolved ownership remains
> commented for future assignment.
>
> The taxonomy checker now validates active rules in the grouped sections, supports the existing glob patterns,
> and reads committed paths so generated files staged by CI do not affect coverage. The checker remains in the
> fast lintrunner set and enforces complete coverage and structural consistency.
>
> To verify that the migration did not silently change existing ownership, I
> resolved the last matching active rule for every committed path before and
> after the change. All 21,647 paths retained the same ordered owner tuple.
>
> <details>
> <summary>Effective CODEOWNERS parity check</summary>
>
> ```python
> import subprocess
>
> from pathspec.patterns.gitwildmatch import GitWildMatchPattern
>
>
> def rules_at(ref):
>     text = subprocess.run(
>         ["git", "show", f"{ref}:CODEOWNERS"],
>         check=True,
>         capture_output=True,
>         text=True,
>     ).stdout
>     rules = []
>     for raw_line in text.splitlines():
>         line = raw_line.strip()
>         if not line or line.startswith("#"):
>             continue
>         fields = line.split()
>         owners = []
>         for field in fields[1:]:
>             if field.startswith("#"):
>                 break
>             owners.append(field)
>         rules.append((GitWildMatchPattern(fields[0]), tuple(owners)))
>     return rules
>
>
> def resolve(path, rules):
>     owners = ()
>     for pattern, candidate in rules:
>         if pattern.match_file(path):
>             owners = candidate
>     return owners
>
>
> paths = subprocess.run(
>     ["git", "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", "HEAD"],
>     check=True,
>     capture_output=True,
>     text=True,
> ).stdout.splitlines()
> before = rules_at("HEAD^")
> after = rules_at("HEAD")
> differences = [
>     path for path in paths if resolve(path, before) != resolve(path, after)
> ]
> print(f"paths={len(paths)} differences={len(differences)}")
> for path in differences:
>     print(path)
> ```
>
> Output:
>
> ```text
> paths=21647 differences=0
> ```
>
> </details>
